skill_name: Compose an essay about the impact of technology on society.
workflow: Technology has had a tremendous influence on society, from digitizing the way we communicate and do business to revolutionizing entertainment and education. With the rapid advancement of technology, more people can now access information anywhere and at any time, which has enabled greater collaboration and productivity.
